AiEvaluationDefinition.name: AVA Voice Agent 2 - Smart Hub Troubleshooting Test Suite

expectation.expectedValue: Agent asks permission to remotely reboot the Smart Hub panel using the scripted line (reboot takes about a minute, security monitoring briefly offline), without disclosing internal IDs or action names.
expectation.name: output_validation

inputs.utterance: My Smart Hub keeps going offline and won't connect to the app.

expectation.expectedValue: Agent acknowledges the decline and escalates the customer to a live agent.
expectation.name: output_validation

inputs.utterance: No thanks, I'd rather talk to a person.

expectation.expectedValue: Agent invokes the Smart Hub reboot action immediately without asking further questions.
expectation.name: output_validation

inputs.utterance: Yes, go ahead and reboot it.

expectation.expectedValue: Agent escalates the customer to a live agent since the issue persists after a successful reboot, without exposing internal status values.
expectation.name: output_validation

inputs.utterance: It rebooted but my Smart Hub is still not connecting.

expectation.expectedValue: Agent automatically triggers the one allowed retry; when the retry also fails, the agent tells the customer both attempts failed and escalates to a live agent without disclosing internal status values or action names.
expectation.name: output_validation

inputs.utterance: That didn't fix it, can you try rebooting it again?

expectation.expectedValue: Agent asks permission to remotely reboot the Smart Hub Pro 2 panel using the same scripted permission line, without disclosing internal IDs or action names.
expectation.name: output_validation

inputs.utterance: My Smart Hub Pro 2 keeps dropping offline and won't stay connected.

expectation.expectedValue: Agent treats this as a Smart Hub malfunction and asks permission to remotely reboot the panel, since a remote reboot is the only troubleshooting step it can perform.
expectation.name: output_validation

inputs.utterance: I think my Smart Hub's firmware needs updating, it hasn't updated in a while.

expectation.expectedValue: Following the customer's agreement in the prior turn, the agent invokes the Smart Hub reboot action immediately and says nothing else.
expectation.name: output_validation

inputs.utterance: Okay, go ahead and reboot it now.

expectation.expectedValue: Agent asks permission to remotely reboot the Smart Hub Pro 2 panel using the scripted permission line, without disclosing internal IDs or action names.
expectation.name: output_validation

inputs.utterance: My Smart Hub Pro 2 says it has a firmware update pending but it never finishes.

expectation.expectedValue: Following the customer's agreement in the prior turn, the agent invokes the Smart Hub reboot action immediately and says nothing else.
expectation.name: output_validation

inputs.utterance: Yes, please reboot my Smart Hub Pro 2.
